## Activity

During October 2022, North City Eye Clinic recorded 478 captures as part of routine site activity. The volume provides the basis for review of image quality and grading outcomes for the month. Activity was documented through the clinic’s usual capture and review process, with results reported for operational monitoring.

## Image quality

Of the 478 captures, 7 were assessed as ungradable. This represents an ungradable rate of 1.5. The result will support ongoing monitoring of image acquisition and may assist the site in identifying opportunities to maintain consistent image quality. No new equipment faults were raised during the month.

## Grading

Grading identified 88 referable results. The median lag between image capture and grading was 2 days. These measures provide a summary of the timeliness of review and the number of results requiring referral or further clinical consideration. The findings should be considered alongside the activity and image-quality measures when reviewing North City Eye Clinic’s performance for October 2022.
